title: Actual request bytes are bounded before route parsing
description: Individual hardened packet derived from the 2026-09-03 holistic Kitty codebase review at base 70c15583a6afa4aac9a6f6eb11abf840afa377a4. It is intentionally separate from active ONE KITTY execution and is not applied by authoring this manifest.

packets.title: Actual request bytes are bounded before route parsing
packets.objective: Replace the header-only global guard with streaming actual-byte enforcement at the ASGI receive boundary. Keep Content-Length as an early rejection optimization, but count `http.request` chunks and terminate with 413 once the applicable limit is exceeded without eagerly buffering the body. Centralize route-specific request limits using existing constants: default JSON/body limit 10 MB, voice 25 MB, inventory 10 MB, character/source image limits matching their existing contracts, and a bounded ChatGPT-import allowance used by KH-IMPORT-01. Do not widen a route merely because another route needs a larger cap. Downstream multipart/request parsing must still receive the original stream when under limit. Add regressions for missing, malformed, dishonest-short, exact-limit, and over-limit Content-Length cases plus a streamed multipart case.
acceptance_criteria: A body larger than its route limit is rejected even when Content-Length is absent.
A client that declares a smaller Content-Length than it actually sends cannot exceed the real byte cap.
Valid chunked and multipart bodies under their route-specific limits reach the route unchanged.
Malformed or negative Content-Length remains a 400 and an honestly oversized header is rejected before body consumption.
Route-specific larger caps do not widen unrelated API routes.
The limiter streams/counts bytes and does not buffer an entire request merely to measure it.
validation_commands: python -m ruff check gateway/app.py gateway/constants.py gateway/request_limits.py tests/test_app_input_validation.py
